slides.headline: She came to Canada from India at age four. In 2026, she was named one of its Top 25 immigrants.
Supinder Wraich was named a Top 25 Canadian Immigrant Award winner for 2026, in the Arts & Culture category
slides.body: Born in India, she moved to Toronto's Rexdale neighbourhood at age four. The 18th annual awards, presented by Western Union, are chosen through a judged process plus over 50,000 public votes.

slides.headline: She created, wrote, and starred in CBC Gem's 'The 410' - and won a 2025 Canadian Screen Award for her role in 'Allegiance.'
slides.body: She's built a career on both sides of the camera, bringing Punjabi and South Asian stories to mainstream Canadian television rather than only acting in others' projects.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A Viksit Bharat benefits when its stories get told by people who write, star in, and produce them themselves.
slides.body: Wraich's path - from India to Rexdale to Canadian primetime - is a reminder that cultural representation and creative ownership are part of what global Indian success looks like too.
